.claude-plugin/plugin.json.why: Two version lines. This repository's marketplace (ADR 0044) versions the plugin it serves, and the incubator assigns its own on promotion. Everything else in the manifest must match.

.claude-plugin/deploys.json.why: gate-secrets is at contractVersion 7 here, since #122 (2026-08-31), and 6 as published. skill-update reads this to tell an adopter a gate is stale, so an adopter installing from ee-skills is not told. No amendment has carried the plugin's own manifest files.

README.md.why: Rewritten here for adopters: what you get, where to start, and `uv run register-check` rather than a bare name (ADR 0020). The published README is the Phase 2 text, which still lists register-check as an unbuilt Phase 3 skill. No amendment has carried the plugin's root README.

skills/*/SKILL.md.why: Each copy names its own repository's skill map: docs/02-skill-family.md here, docs/skill-relationship-map.md in the incubator, which substitutes it on promotion (docs/05-promotion.md row 8).
